program: Wingless training-only marginal-state signal on disjoint future data
question: Can a target-label-free change in the learned predictor state identify which fixed adaptation intervals are capable of producing positive sealed-evaluation gain on the disjoint dataset where the R15 marginal curve failed to transfer?
hypothesis: Replay the exact R17 disjoint manifest, leave-one-domain-out 15,819-byte non-target budget, 256-motif capacity, 582-byte sealed evaluation and frozen R17 budget grids. Before reading sealed-evaluation outcomes for an interval, compute STATE_DELTA between its lower- and upper-budget training models: baseline_argmax_change_count + motif_entry_count + motif_exit_count + retained_motif_best_change_count. The signal uses training/adaptation bytes only and no evaluation labels. Supported requires every interval with positive sealed-evaluation gain to have STATE_DELTA>0 (zero false negatives) and at least one zero-gain interval to have STATE_DELTA=0, demonstrating nontrivial selectivity. Mixed requires zero false negatives but no zero-gain interval with STATE_DELTA=0. Negative if any positive-gain interval has STATE_DELTA=0. This experiment does not select or retain an allocation policy.

prior_evidence.interpretation: The originating allocation curve was not portable; the next question is whether a training-only model-state signal can detect marginal opportunity without sealed labels.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

classification_rules.invalid: any parent, authority, source, split, budget-grid, state-delta formula, capacity, deterministic replay, provenance, or accounting requirement fails

no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter transfer sources, 15,819-byte non-target budget, 256 capacity, 582/872 split, R17 budget grids, STATE_DELTA formula, evaluator, thresholds, classification, or authority after primary output.

successor_if_supported.intent: test whether normalized training-state delta ranks marginal value strongly enough for a frozen budget allocator without using sealed labels

successor_if_mixed_or_negative.intent: factor baseline-transition, motif-entry/exit, and best-successor-change components before another policy experiment
